footerNote: DoorDash reports cost of revenue before depreciation. The $70M of depreciation tied to cost of revenue is included in cost above, so the gross profit shown ($1,689M) matches DoorDash's published figure. Net income attributable to DoorDash stockholders was $244M (a $1M loss sat with non-controlling interests).
oneTimers: The chart's net profit is $243M — net income including redeemable non-controlling interests. After a $1M loss attributable to those interests, $244M was attributable to DoorDash common stockholders, the headline figure.

Other expense of $81M was almost entirely a non-cash unrealized loss on the deal-contingent currency forward hedging the £2.8B Deliveroo purchase price; the forward was settled on October 8, 2025, when the deal closed.
General and administrative costs include $48M of certain legal, tax, and regulatory settlements, reserves, and expenses, and $17M of transaction-related costs, mostly for the Deliveroo acquisition.
otherDetail: Interest and other items netted −$10M — $71M of interest income, net, less $81M of other expense, net (mostly the non-cash Deliveroo hedge loss).

segments.name: Marketplace services
segments.note: Commissions from restaurants and stores, delivery fees, and DashPass/Wolt+ memberships across DoorDash's marketplaces. DoorDash reports one revenue stream.

takeaways.text: Gross order value rose 25% to $25.0B on 776M orders. DoorDash keeps only a slice of each order — $3.4B of revenue from $25.0B of goods is the whole model in one line.
takeaways.title: The marketplace keeps compounding

takeaways.text: Net income rose 51% to $244M from $162M a year ago, and operating income more than doubled to $258M from $107M. An $81M non-cash loss on the Deliveroo currency hedge sat in other expense — without it, the bottom line would have been higher still.
takeaways.title: Profit jumped even with a hedge loss

takeaways.text: Adjusted EBITDA rose 41% to $754M (3.0% of GOV) and free cash flow was $723M. Deliveroo closed on October 2, taking the combined business past 50M monthly users and $100B in annualized order value.
takeaways.title: Cash machine, and Deliveroo is now in

verdict: DoorDash's marketplace kept compounding — orders up 21%, the value of goods ordered up 25% to $25.0B — and net income rose 51% to $244M even after an $81M non-cash loss on the currency hedge for the Deliveroo deal.
